title: Cross-Visibility-Gap Identity Persistence for 4D Scene Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 4D scene graphs require persistent object identity when an object disappears inside an opaque carrier and later reappears as a fresh detection. When appearance and target-centric motion are unavailable, identity recovery must rely on relational history. We formulate cross-visibility-gap identity persistence as historical-node recovery through a remembered target--carrier binding.   We introduce CVG-SGM, a perception-frontend-compatible transfer--maintain--read memory. Geometry-weighted cross-node interaction transfers target-specific evidence into carrier states, a shared per-node GRU maintains this information during transport, and a two-time readout combines stored carrier--identity compatibility with current detection--carrier geometry to recover the historical identity.   In the controlled one-identity-per-carrier setting, CVG-SGM achieves 1.000 re-link accuracy, compared with 0.570 for both no-memory and parameter-count-matched no

translated_title: 面向4D场景图的跨可见性间隙身份持久性
translated_abstract: 4D场景图要求当物体消失于不透明载体内部并在稍后作为全新检测重新出现时，保持物体身份的持久性。当外观特征和以目标为中心的运动信息不可用时，身份恢复必须依赖关系历史。我们将跨可见性间隙身份持续性问题表述为通过记忆的目标-载体绑定进行历史节点恢复。我们提出了CVG-SGM，这是一种与感知前端兼容的“转移-维持-读取”记忆机制：几何加权的跨节点交互将目标特定的证据转移到载体状态中，一个共享的逐节点GRU在运输过程中维持这些信息，两时刻读取机制将存储的载体-身份兼容性与当前的检测-载体几何相结合以恢复历史身份。在受控的单载体单身份设置中，CVG-SGM实现了1.000的重新链接准确率，而无记忆模型和参数量匹配的模型（摘要在此处截断）仅为0.570。
tldr: 提出CVG-SGM记忆机制，通过“转移-维持-读取”架构记住物体与载体的绑定关系，使物体在穿过不透明载体消失后重新出现时能够恢复历史身份，重新链接准确率达1.000。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CVG-SGM, a transfer-maintain-read memory mechanism that remembers target-carrier bindings to recover historical object identities when objects reappear after disappearing inside opaque carriers, achieving perfect 1.000 re-link accuracy in 4D scene graphs.
